title: Delivered-pack recall/notify channel protocol (M2 delivery precondition)
context: PLAN v0.2 adds a pre-agreed partner recall/notify channel as an explicit M2 delivery precondition — not just a sustainability nicety. Printed offline cards cannot be patched; a discovered Tier-C defect (mistranslation that could cause harm) found after distribution needs a pre-agreed notify path to reach the field. The channel must be agreed with the partner before the first delivery. The delivery also carries a version + QR/short-code pointing to the latest version + errata so distributed cards can reference current information. The existing maint-001 task documents the general withdrawal procedure for sources/locale/license changes, but does not cover the specific partner recall/notify channel that must be pre-agreed as an M2 delivery precondition. The existing delivery-001 task does not mention this precondition either.
objective: Document the delivered-pack recall/notify channel protocol and record it as a required pre-agreed commitment from the M2 partner before first delivery.
acceptanceCriteria: Protocol defines the recall/notify channel: the mechanism by which a discovered Tier-C defect (post-distribution) is communicated to the partner and to field users of printed cards
Specifies that the channel must be agreed in writing with the partner before M2 delivery and recorded in the delivery record (delivery-001)

Documents the version + QR/short-code-to-latest requirement for every delivered printed pack (so a field user can reference the latest version and errata without the project having push access to distributed cards)

Describes the withdrawal procedure specifically for offline printed cards (including what 'recall' means when cards are physically distributed — partner responsibility for replacement / destruction / re-distribution)
States that any Tier-C defect discovered post-distribution triggers the recall/notify channel regardless of the card's age
Ties into the outcome log (outcomes-001) and the general withdrawal procedure (maint-001)
